sharedRequirements.SH-01: Existing current identity, tenant, owner and manager policy; explicit HR-only compensation/succession
sharedRequirements.SH-02: Independent requisition, hire, review and compensation decisions; shared inbox delegation not extended
sharedRequirements.SH-03: Committed workflow status and histories; scheduled reminders/delivery processing remain unimplemented for talent
sharedRequirements.SH-04: Bounded talent registers and persisted scenario comparison; exports/reporting suite remain open
sharedRequirements.SH-05: Atomic actor/time/reason/correlation and before/after history with database retention guards
sharedRequirements.SH-06: Per-review rating/date and course-role/validity configuration; enterprise policies remain open
sharedRequirements.SH-08: Real in-process Core HR hire/activation and durable payroll receipt; no vendor connection
sharedRequirements.SH-09: Explicit planning currency and UTC dates; translations/country policy remain open
sharedRequirements.SH-10: Restricted confidential access; deletion/legal-hold/retention configuration remains release work
